coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of the 6 ground-truth variable items at a broad semantic level: gradient-method comparison, computation-time measurement, and numerical-stability assessment using loss trajectories and gradient norms/comparisons.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The platform sweep omits GPU and distributed multi-GPU, and the models replace ResNet18/ResNet50 with MLP, small CNN, and quadratic tasks. Adam with fixed batch size and identical training pipelines is not maintained: batch size varies, SGD is allowed, and the branches perform different training computations. Timing also does not cleanly separate forward and backward durations; a forward-plus-backward region is mislabeled backward-only.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the expected conclusion that TorchOpt should reduce computation and enhance numerical stability, verifiable through comparisons of computation time and memory use against traditional back-propagation.
